EmailTemplate.subject: Elite365 - Interview Prep
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hey there,
You are officially submitted out! Here's a few things I like to remind all my travelers about the interview process.
The facility might call you, email you, or text you - so be on the lookout for all three. Any communication you have with someone from the facility, reach out to me immediately for an update. Even if you miss a call! :-)
Things to write down: *Managers Name: *Managers Number: *Start Date: *Requested time off: *Length of assignment: *Shift information (times/call etc.): *Any other information you feel I need to know, have questions about, or why you wouldn't immediately accept:
Don't be afraid to ask for the job travel managers love that! Or if there's anything you're hesitant about, please ask them at the interview and let me know as well.
I'm really excited for you and us starting this journey together.
